name: revenuemagnet
description: Build it, and they will come: "it" being the growth system around your product. Revenue Magnet maps everyone already around a builder's product, from their own mail, calendar and analytics, and drafts the next part to build: a page for a search, a directory listing, a post. Needs the Revenue Magnet desktop app, installed separately; when you ask for growth work, Claude Code offers to do it in the app and asks if that is OK.
